title: Isomorphic Busemann--Petty for arbitrary measures: the sharp order
summary: Let $C_n$ be the optimal constant with the following property. For every even, continuous, strictly positive density $f$ on $R^n$ and all origin-symmetric convex bodies $K,L\subset R^n$, the inequalities $$ \int_{K\capξ^\perp}f \leq \int_{L\capξ^\perp}f \qquad\text{for all }ξ\in S^{n-1} $$ imply $\int_Kf\leq C_n\int_Lf$. In an earlier paper the authors proved that $C_n\leq\sqrt n$. In this paper, we prove the matching lower bound $C_n\geq c\sqrt n$.
